title: MarqRadar: A Free Threat Scan for Every Brand, in 90 Seconds
summary: MarqRadar is a free brand risk scanner that scans the web for counterfeits, fake domains, content, and ads impersonating your brand.
body_markdown:
Most brands don't discover counterfeits by looking for them. They discover them when a customer complains about a fake, when revenue dips in a market they thought they owned, or when legal forwards a screenshot of a lookalike site.


‍


By then, the threat has been live for weeks. Sometimes months.


‍


The problem isn't that brands ignore this. It's that seeing your full threat exposure has always required a vendor evaluation, a scoping call, and weeks of setup, so most teams simply don't look until something forces them to.


‍


Today we're removing that barrier.[MarqRadar](https://marqvision.com/marqradar) is a free threat scanner that shows your brand's exposure in under 90 seconds. Enter your brand name or website. That's it.


‍


‍


**What one scan covers**


‍


MarqRadar checks your brand across the five major channels where counterfeits and impersonation actually happen:


‍


- Lookalike domains (typosquats and copycat sites)
- Marketplace counterfeit listings
- Social media
- Paid ads
- Website content (copied product pages and brand abuse).


‍


**Every finding comes back scored** : a risk score, a severity rating, and a takedown difficulty, so you can see not just what's out there, but what's worth acting on. The free Lite report shows your top findings instantly; the full version (available on demand) is delivered to your inbox or walked through live with one of our brand protection professionals.


‍


**Built on the same AI engine that does this at scale** : MarqRadar runs on the same AI detection technology MarqVision used to detect and remove more than 60 million infringements in 2025. The free report is the high-level surface scan; a full MarqVision scan typically surfaces 10 to 100 times more threats across all channels.


‍


You can't protect what you can't see. Seeing now takes 90 seconds.


‍


[Scan my brand free](https://marqvision.com/marqradar)
